description: Generator Gen A ('Jenny') seized completely on Day 4. Initially appeared catastrophic.
response: Root cause was a long-overdue oil change; the air filter had not been changed since 2009. Engine recovered fully once serviced.
lesson: Service all generators on arrival regardless of apparent status. Include matched air filters, oil, and filter in the pre-mission spare parts kit.
